query: Получай курсы валют с https://api.exchangerate.host/latest и сохраняй результат в файл /data/output/rates.json.

runs.yaml_pim:
flow:
  id: exchange_rates_pipeline
  name: Exchange Rates Pipeline
  description: Fetch currency exchange rates from API and save to file
triggers:
- id: trigger_main
  type: schedule
  condition: every day
sources:
- id: source_api
  name: Exchange Rate API
  type: HTTP
  location: https://api.exchangerate.host/latest
  connection:
    properties:
      method: GET
processing_elements: []
sinks:
- id: sink_file
  name: Save to File
  type: File
  location: /data/output/rates.json
processed_data:
- id: rates_json
  format: json
links:
- from_id: source_api
  to_id: sink_file
  data_ref: rates_json
